description: This file defines the GenericProvider class, a part of the league/oauth2-client library, which implements a generic OAuth 2.0 service provider using Bearer token authentication. It includes configuration, validation, and methods for OAuth 2.0 interactions.

classes.name: GenericProvider
classes.description: A generic OAuth 2.0 service provider class that handles configuration, validation, and OAuth 2.0 flow methods, using Bearer token authentication.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with options and collaborators, validating required options and setting configurable properties.

methods.name: getConfigurableOptions
methods.description: Returns an array of options that can be configured for this provider.

methods.name: getRequiredOptions
methods.description: Returns an array of options that are required for this provider.

methods.name: assertRequiredOptions
methods.description: Checks if all required options are present; throws exception if any are missing.

methods.name: getBaseAuthorizationUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for the OAuth 2.0 authorization endpoint.

methods.name: getBaseAccessTokenUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for obtaining access tokens.

methods.name: getResourceOwnerDetailsUrl
methods.description: Returns the URL for fetching resource owner details.

methods.name: getDefaultScopes
methods.description: Returns the default scopes for the OAuth 2.0 request.

methods.name: getAccessTokenMethod
methods.description: Returns the HTTP method used for access token requests.

methods.name: getAccessTokenResourceOwnerId
methods.description: Returns the property name for resource owner ID in access token responses.

methods.name: getScopeSeparator
methods.description: Returns the separator used in scope strings.

methods.name: getPkceMethod
methods.description: Returns the PKCE method used, if any.

methods.name: checkResponse
methods.description: Checks the API response for errors and throws exceptions if needed.

methods.name: createResourceOwner
methods.description: Creates a resource owner object from the response data.
